# AI Web Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/ai-web-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/ai-web-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.2.26**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

AI-first web scraper that extracts structured data from any website using natural-language prompts.
No programming knowledge required.
No hard-coded logic that breaks when a website changes.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Page extraction $0.03, Actor Start $0.00025 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/ai-web-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-ai-web-scraper@0.2.26#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      startUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startUrls` | array | yes |  | Start URLs — URLs to start crawling from. |
| `extractionMode` | string |  | `"single"` | Extraction mode — **Single page:** Extracts data relevant to the prompt only from Start URLs. Links are not followed, maximum crawl depth is ignored. Best when you already have the exact pages and just want structured data. **Scout:** Uses sitemaps to find pages relevant to your prompt (up to Max pa |
| `prompt` | string |  | `""` | Page extraction prompt — Natural language description of which items to find and what to extract from each. If empty, the Actor just returns each start URL's content as Markdown (no crawling). |
| `maxPagesToVisit` | integer |  | `100` | Max pages to visit — Applied per Start URL. So the overall cap of pages to visit is this number × the number of Start URLs (e.g. 10 Start URLs × 5 = up to 50 pages). Ignored in Single page mode. Number of relevant results may be smaller. |
| `maxCrawlDepth` | integer |  | `5` | Max crawl depth — How many link hops away from the Start URL the crawler may follow. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
